facts.statement: The Company undertook a Double Materiality Assessment to identify and prioritise key ESG matters based on their societal, environmental, and financial implications.
facts.quote: During the year, the Company undertook a Double  Materiality Assessment (“DMA”) to identify and prioritise  key ESG matters based on their impact on society and  the environment, as well as their potential financial  implications for the Company.

facts.statement: Asian Paints (Polymers) Private Limited was a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company amalgamated with effect from 31st March 2026.
facts.quote: Scheme of Amalgamation  of Asian Paints (Polymers) Private Limited, a wholly owned  subsidiary of Company, with the Company, with effect from  31st March 2026

facts.statement: Unclaimed dividend amounting to ₹ 2.13 crores and 93,915 equity shares were transferred to the Investor Education and Protection Fund.
facts.quote: unclaimed dividend amounting to  ₹ 2.13 crores and 93,915 equity shares were transferred  by the Company to the Investor Education and Protection  Fund (“IEPF”)

facts.statement: The Company is a party to proceedings before the Competition Commission of India and an appellate forum.
facts.quote: The Company is a party to proceedings before the  Competition Commission of India and in a separate matter  before the appellate forum in relation to certain allegations  under the Competition Act, 2002.

facts.statement: During the financial year 2025-26, the Company did not accept any deposit within the meaning of Sections 73 and 74 of the Act.
facts.quote: During the year, the Company has not accepted any  deposit within the meaning of Sections 73 and 74 of the  Act read with the Companies (Acceptance of Deposits)  Rules, 2014.

facts.statement: MUFG Intime India Private Limited serves as the Registrar and Share Transfer Agent of the Company.
facts.quote: MUFG Intime India Private Limited (formerly Link Intime India  Private Limited) is the Registrar and Share Transfer Agent of  the Company.
